name: agents-installed
assertion: All three CLI agents (gemini, claude, codex) are installed and return version info

name: dispatch-prompt-template
assertion: Every subagent prompt includes CONTEXT, TASK, FILES YOU OWN, CONSTRAINTS, and DELIVERABLE sections

name: no-file-overlap
assertion: No two parallel subagents are assigned the same file in their FILES YOU OWN section

name: notification-chained
assertion: Background dispatches chain notify.mjs for completion alerts

name: orchestrator-for-projects
assertion: Multi-phase project work uses orchestrator.mjs, not manual dispatch
